package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_returns_persistence_model_directly: Handlers that serialize database models directly to the client instead of mapping to response DTOs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type Product struct {
	gorm.Model
	SKU       string  `json:"sku" gorm:"column:sku"`
	Name      string  `json:"name" gorm:"column:name"`
	Price     float64 `json:"price" gorm:"column:price"`
	CostPrice float64 `json:"cost_price" gorm:"column:cost_price"`
	StockQty  int     `json:"stock_qty" gorm:"column:stock_qty"`
}

func GetProductHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	product := Product{
		SKU:       "ABC-123",
		Name:      "Widget",
		Price:     29.99,
		CostPrice: 15.00,
		StockQty:  100,
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, product)
}
